d: An anthropomorphic owl with an athletic build, featuring sharp, amber-colored eyes and a hooked beak. The creature is covered in cream and off-white plumage, with a dense ruff of feathers around the neck and yellow-orange crest feathers atop the head. It wears an ornate teal and pale-green tunic with gold trim, a brown leather shoulder guard, and matching teal bracers, accessorized by a white belt with a gold buckle and a small brown pouch. BODY COLOR: cream and off-white LEGS: not visible
